correctness.rationale: For every real period-2 point, exact elimination yields u=sin(Au)cos(Bv), v=cos(Au)sin(Bv); |A|<=1 forces u=0 and strict monotonicity of sin(t)/t for 0<t<pi establishes zero/one primitive cycle. At B=pi/2, cos(Bv)=0 makes the common Jacobian nilpotent of order three, so the return Jacobian cube vanishes. The implicit function theorem gives v=1+O(detuning^2), t=-detuning+O(detuning^2); the three characteristic roots of lambda^3+rt lambda^2-qt lambda-pt have moduli |pt|^(1/3)(1+O(|t|^(1/3))) at fixed p!=0. Squaring gives the exact 2/3 law. 224 finite numerical checks corroborate equations only.

value.rationale: The source family is specifically investigated for coexisting periodic/chaotic motion and symmetry, but the literature largely reports numerical phase diagrams. The result completely enumerates primitive period-two orbits on a natural two-dimensional coefficient strip, finds a whole nilpotent superattracting sheet at an exact symmetry-selected phase, and exhibits a singular 2/3 rather than linear Floquet detuning law. This gives a structural phase-space and stability mechanism not obtainable from plotted Lyapunov windows; no speculative application claims are needed.
